clause_ref: IT Outsourcing and Third-Party Risk Policy
text:
IT Outsourcing and Third-Party Risk Policy
Bharat Unity Bank Ltd.

heading_path: IT Outsourcing and Third-Party Risk Policy
IT Outsourcing and Third-Party Risk Policy
1. Purpose and Scope
text: 1.1 This Policy governs all arrangements under which the Bank uses third-party service providers for information technology services, including cloud services.

heading_path: IT Outsourcing and Third-Party Risk Policy
IT Outsourcing and Third-Party Risk Policy
2. Governance
text: 2.1 Board policy and IT Strategy Committee oversight [ITO-C01]. The Board shall approve this Policy, and the IT Strategy Committee shall oversee all IT outsourcing arrangements and review this Policy at least annually. Control owner: Chief Information Officer. Frequency: Annual.

heading_path: IT Outsourcing and Third-Party Risk Policy
IT Outsourcing and Third-Party Risk Policy
3. Onboarding of Service Providers
text: 3.1 Materiality assessment and register [ITO-C02]. Each IT outsourcing arrangement shall be assessed for materiality before onboarding, and all arrangements shall be recorded in the Outsourcing Register with their materiality classification. Control owner: Head of Vendor Management. Frequency: Event Driven.

heading_path: IT Outsourcing and Third-Party Risk Policy
3. Onboarding of Service Providers
text: 3.2 Service provider due diligence [ITO-C03]. Before entering into an arrangement, the Bank shall conduct due diligence on the service provider covering financial soundness, technical capability, reputation and information security posture. Control owner: Head of Vendor Management. Frequency: Event Driven.

heading_path: IT Outsourcing and Third-Party Risk Policy
IT Outsourcing and Third-Party Risk Policy
4. Contractual Requirements
text: 4.1 Audit and access rights in contracts [ITO-C04]. Every outsourcing agreement shall provide for the right of the Bank and the Reserve Bank of India, or persons authorised by them, to access and audit the service provider, together with clauses on confidentiality, sub-contracting and termination. Control owner: Head of Legal. Frequency: Event Driven.

heading_path: IT Outsourcing and Third-Party Risk Policy
IT Outsourcing and Third-Party Risk Policy
5. Ongoing Monitoring
text: 5.1 Annual risk assessment of material providers [ITO-C05]. Material service providers shall be subjected to a risk assessment at least annually, and the results shall be reported to the IT Strategy Committee. Control owner: Head of Vendor Management. Frequency: Annual.

heading_path: IT Outsourcing and Third-Party Risk Policy
5. Ongoing Monitoring
text: 5.2 Quarterly review of service-provider privileged access [ITO-C06]. Privileged access granted to service-provider personnel on Bank systems shall be reviewed every quarter, and access that is no longer required shall be revoked. Control owner: Chief Information Security Officer. Frequency: Quarterly.

heading_path: IT Outsourcing and Third-Party Risk Policy
5. Ongoing Monitoring
text: 5.3 Concentration risk monitoring [ITO-C07]. Concentration risk arising from reliance on a single service provider shall be monitored and reported to the IT Strategy Committee every six months. Control owner: Chief Information Officer. Frequency: Semi Annual.

heading_path: IT Outsourcing and Third-Party Risk Policy
IT Outsourcing and Third-Party Risk Policy
6. Business Continuity and Exit
text: 6.1 Joint DR drill with material providers [ITO-C08]. For each material outsourcing arrangement, the Bank shall maintain a Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery plan with the service provider and conduct a joint disaster recovery drill at least annually. Control owner: Head of IT Infrastructure. Frequency: Annual.

heading_path: IT Outsourcing and Third-Party Risk Policy
6. Business Continuity and Exit
text: 6.2 Exit strategy [ITO-C09]. A documented exit strategy, including transition arrangements, shall be maintained for every material outsourcing arrangement. Control owner: Head of Vendor Management. Frequency: Annual.
